name: BRAND TEXT
description:
HELO takes great care of every customer, providing expert solutions in constructing every Infrared Sauna unit for the most comfortable and safest way to enjoy and benefit from Infrared Sauna therapy at home. Certified experts put together their experience, knowledge and newest technology to build a perfect in every detail Infrared Sauna for indoor use so that it will not only give the best sauna experience, but also withstand the passing of time and answer every preference you might have.



Infrared Saunas help achieve the ultimate goal of a healthy life with no problem, assisting with various health problems and aiding with detoxification and weight loss in a safe and low cost environment. HELO puts its passion for saunas to a level so high that each unit provides a genuine experience during which the soothing warmth of Infrared therapy rewards you with a relaxing, rejuvenating session without harm and hassle



The vast line of various Infrared Sauna choices in the HELO catalogue can answer anyone’s most picky preferences. Top quality craftsmanship and materials used for the construction of each sauna unit comply with all the possible safety regulations and minimize any harm that can be caused by the use of the Sauna and the process of construction to the environment.
